with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to their respective league of his province according to the [[Argentine football league system]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. ===Relegation Playoff Matches=== Each tie was played on a home-and-away two-legged basis, but if the first match was won by the team of [[Primera B Nacional]] (who also played the first leg at home), there was no need to play the second. If instead, the team from the [[List of regional football leagues in Argentina|Regional leagues]] wins the first leg, the second leg must be played, leg that, if its won by the team of [[Primera B Nacional]], a third leg must be played, if the third leg finishes in a tie, the team from [[Primera B Nacional]] remains on it.
